analysis: Agreement of two response classifications, not quality-of-life surrogacy
locations: Discussion: overlap counts by randomized arm
population: Pooled mixed-age behavioral-trial completers, not an adult-only validation
reference_positive: CGI-I Much Improved or Very Much Improved at week 10
index_positive: At least 25 percent YGTSS Total Tic Score reduction from baseline
ci_method: Pointwise Wilson 95 percent intervals, z=1.959963984540054. Conditional on a threshold selected in the same pooled sample; ignores selection optimism and trial/site clustering.
restrictions: No age-specific table; no GTS-QOL joint outcome; no inference about treatment-effect surrogacy or a severe-state threshold. Armwise positive predictive values condition on a postrandomization response and are not randomized treatment effects.
